highlights.text: Benchmarks 2026: mid-market SaaS logo churn clusters at 6-8% a year. Vendors reporting under 2% are usually quoting net revenue churn after expansion, not logo churn. Always ask which definition a deck uses.
Net revenue retention above 115% usually means the vendor expands inside existing accounts faster than it loses them. It says nothing about how many logos leave. Read NDR and logo churn as a pair.
Second meetings are for disproving the thesis, not confirming it. Go in with one number to break and one question the founders hope you will not ask.
